bundle.shortDescription: Collaborative review of Markdown documents and HTML reports.
bundle.longDescription: Forgemark is a desktop app for collaborative review of Markdown documents and generated HTML reports — by humans and AI agents working as peers. Comments, threaded replies, and suggested edits live inside the file itself.
